Name: Adjustable Stamina Healing
Author: yakminepunyo
Description:
[b]Adjustable Stamina Healing(ASH)

[Oveview]
[/b]This mod was created to adjust game difficulty by increasing/decreasing player character's stamina (or health) over time.
And you can change the value to heal/decay in-game, even disable modifying by setting the value to zero.

That's it.
This project is Open Source and the codes are available at [url=https://github.com/pomepome/AdjustableStaminaHealing]GitHub[/url]﻿ under the GPLv3 License
Feel free to comment, or endorse if you like it.

[b][Requirement]
[/b]This mod requires [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿ in order to work.

[b][Configuration]
[/b][i]SecondsNeededToStartHealing [/i](int, default:3, minimum:0) - seconds the farmer needs to stand still to start healing. If he/she is moving, healing will stop.
[i]HealingValuePerSeconds            [/i](float, default:0.5, minimum:0.0, maximum:2.0) - The value to affect farmer's stamina and health.
[i]HealHealth                                    [/i](bool, default:false) - This option toggles whether to heal also health.
[i]StopHealingWhileGamePaused[/i] (bool, default:true) - Weather heal while game is paused (Any events, Opening menu).
[i]IncreaseKey                                  [/i](Keys, default:79) - The key to increase the value of [i]HealingValuePerSeconds[/i] by 0.1 in-game.
[i]DecreaseKey                                 [/i](Keys, default:80) - The key to decrease the value of [i]HealingValuePerSeconds [/i]by 0.1 in-game.
